reason: I check Google and Trustpilot before I contact anyone, and there's nothing to check here: no UK reviews, one anonymous project in Kuwait and a demo for a made-up plumber. Pay-when-happy is nice, but I'd still be giving up hours to calls and rounds of changes with someone I can't vet.
objection: Zero reviews from anyone I can verify, and he's in Kuwait. If it drags on or he goes quiet, I've lost the time I don't have, and I don't fancy chasing someone abroad for hosting fixes for years.
would_change_my_mind: A handful of real, named UK reviews on Google or Trustpilot from businesses like mine, ideally ones I could call or visit.
